notes.title: Patch Notes [27 Dec 2024]
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Instructions for each game is now listed during the pregame setup and through the options button.
[*]Checker pieces now highlight when the piece is forced to jump.
[*]Fixed issue with pawn promotion not being relayed to the other player.
[*]Increased the volume of all music and sound effects.
[*]In CheckersChess/Combination, added tooltips for each of the chess piece tokens' explaining how to earn each token for each chess piece.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes [15 Dec 2024]
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]A new game, Checkers-Chess/Combination, has landed! This game combines aspects of checkers and chess into a unique, yet similar experience. Start by selecting a formation, once the game starts, you perform certain objectives to earn tokens for chess pieces, allowing you to elevate checker pieces into chess pieces. After some time, the king will enter the battle and the first player to capture the opponent's king wins!
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes [4 Dec. 2024]
notes.notes:

[*]All achievements are now obtainable
[*]Game now opens in full-screen mode instead of windowed 900x900
[*]Slightly increased main menu music volume
[*]Changed the UI screens in the main menu
[/list]
